question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"accept."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The infinitive of a verb has two forms: the **to-infinitive** and the infinitive without to.
 
• The **to-form** consists of to plus the base form of the verb.
 
 
• **Example**: *I want **to speak**__ to you.*
 
 
 
• **"Accept"** means to agree to or receive something willingly. ((दी गई वस्‍तु को) स्‍वीकार या ग्रहण करना)
 __
 
• **Example**:* Please **accept**__ this small gift.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that someone needs to fill in a blank, and the correct word to use is **"accept."**
